title: IRCO Decision Rules Schema v0
description: Defines the structure for deterministic health surveillance rules. Rules are loaded from JSON files and evaluated by the Rust decision engine without recompilation.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier. Convention: {INDICATOR}_{TYPE}_{SEQ}. Example: HR_THRESHOLD_001.

indicator.description: Target indicator name (must match pivot indicator field).

params.description: Parameters specific to the condition type.

deviation_percent.description: Minimum absolute percentage deviation from the numeric context.individual_baseline. When configured with deviation_absolute, either threshold triggers the rule.

deviation_absolute.description: Minimum absolute deviation from the numeric context.individual_baseline. When configured with deviation_percent, either threshold triggers the rule.

window_hours.description: Time window in hours for trend/persistence analysis.

min_samples.description: Minimum valid samples in the window.

slope_threshold.description: Signed slope threshold per day: non-negative values trigger at or above the threshold; negative values trigger at or below it.

persistence_count.description: Number of consecutive violations for persistent_deviation.

deviation_direction.description: Direction of the percentage deviation for persistent_deviation.

max_gap_hours.description: Maximum acceptable gap before missing_data triggers.

sub_rules.description: For composite rules: rule IDs combined using composite_operator.

context_required.description: Required context fields for the rule to apply. Examples: activity, individual_baseline, sleep_state, mission_phase.

data_class_filter.description: If set, rule only applies to observations of these data classes. Default: all classes.

vigilance_level.description: Vigilance level produced when this rule triggers.

justification_template.description: Human-readable template for the alert justification. Use {indicator}, {value}, {unit}, {threshold}, {baseline}, {window} as placeholders.

scientific_reference.description: Citation or reference supporting this rule's thresholds/logic.

status.description: Validation status of the rule. validated = peer-reviewed thresholds. provisional = reasonable defaults pending validation. illustrative = demonstration only.

priority.description: Priority for conflict resolution when multiple rules fire. Higher = more important.
